'/admin/guides/%d' % guide.id if guide else '/admin/guides' }}\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token(request) }}\">\n    <label>英雄\n      <select name=\"hero_id\" required>\n        <option value=\"\">请选择英雄</option>\n        {% for hero in heroes %}\n        <option value=\"{{ hero.id }}\"{% if hero.id == fields.hero_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ hero.name_zh }}（{{ hero.name_en }}）</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    <label>版本\n      <select name=\"patch_id\" required>\n        {% for patch in patches %}\n        <option value=\"{{ patch.id }}\"{% if patch.id == fields.patch_id %} selected{% endif %}>{{ patch.name }}{% if patch.is_current %}（当前版本）{% endif %}</option>\n        {% endfor %}\n      </select>\n    </label>\n    {% if guide and user.can(\"edit_guide_slugs\") %}\n    <label>网址名（公开网址 guides/网址名/，改动后旧链接会失效）\n      <input type=\"text\" name=\"slug\" value=\"{{ fields.slug }}\" required pattern=\"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\">\n    </label>\n    {% endif %}\n\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>中文版（提交审核前必须填写）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title_zh\" value=\"{{ fields.title_zh }}\">\n      </label>\n      <label>正文（Markdown）\n        <textarea name=\"body_zh\" rows=\"16\">{{ fields.body_zh }}</textarea>\n      </label>\n    </fieldset>\n    <fieldset>\n      <legend>英文版（可选）</legend>\n      <label>标题\n        <input type=\"text\" name=\"title_en\" value=\"{{ fields.title_en }}\">\n      </label>\n      <label>正文（Markdown）\n        <textarea name=\"body_en\" rows=\"16\">{{ fields.body_en }}</textarea>\n      </label>\n    </fieldset>\n\n    <button type=\"submit\">{{ \"保存\" if guide and guide.status != \"draft\" else \"保存草稿\" }}</button>\n    {% if can_submit %}\n    <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/guides/{{ guide.id }}/submit\">提交审核</button>\n    {% endif %}\n    {% if can_publish %}\n    <button type=\"submit\" formaction=\"{{ console_root(request) }}admin/guides/{{ guide.id }}/publish\">发布</button>\n    {% endif %}\n  </form>\n{% endblock Two are correctness bugs and the rest are cleanup. I didn't run the tests.\n\n- **Prefix bug (`app/web.py:70`):** `console_root` is only wrong when the console runs under a path prefix. Starlette 1.7's `request.url.path` includes that prefix, so the \"../\" chain walks back past it and every link drops it.\n- **Weak test (`tests/test_console_links.py:51`):** `check_page` accepts any 403 as \"this route exists\", so it never actually checks the Guide filter form's GET link.\n- **Cleanup:** a `&lt;base href&gt;` in `admin/base.html` would replace about 30 copies of the prefix; the prefix is also recomputed for every link; some test assertions are hard-coded to one URL depth; and `home_for`/`redirect` still use root-absolute paths, though those are redirect headers rather than HTML.\n- **No CLAUDE.md breaks:** I searched `templates/` and `app/` for `href|src|action|formaction=\"/` and got no hits.\n\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/web.py\",\n    \"line\": 70,\n    \"summary\": \"console_root counts slashes in request.url.path, which in Starlette 1.7 includes root_path, so under a path prefix the '../' chain climbs past the console root and every console link loses the prefix.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Run the console with `uvicorn --root-path /cms` (or behind a proxy that serves it at /cms). On /cms/admin/guides, url.path is '/cms/admin/guides', so console_root returns '../../'. Resolved from /cms/admin/, 'admin/guides' becomes /admin/guides and not /cms/admin/guides, so every nav link, form action and formaction is a 404. Count from request.scope['path'] with root_path removed, or count only the segments after root_path.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"tests/test_console_links.py\",\n    \"line\": 51,\n    \"summary\": \"check_page takes any 403 on a bare POST as proof that the target route exists, but POST /admin/guides exists (Guide create), so the Guide filter form's GET action is never checked as a GET and the 405 branch is dead.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"If the filter form's action were broken so it pointed at a POST-only route, or its GET handler went away, POST still returns the CSRF 403 and the test passes. The comment 'Form GETs (the Guide filters) carry no token and just answer' describes a path that never runs. Read the form's method attribute and GET method=get targets directly.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"templates/admin/base.html\",\n    \"line\": 35,\n    \"summary\": \"Altitude: the same prefix is pasted in front of about 30 links in 12 templates, when one &lt;base href=\\\"{{ console_root(request) }}\\\"&gt; in admin/base.html (or a per-request context value) would make every plain 'admin/...' link relative to the console root.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Every new console link has to remember the prefix by hand. A link added without it (for example href=\\\"admin/heroes\\\" on a depth-2 page) resolves to /admin/admin/heroes. Only the crawl test would catch it, and only for pages that test lists.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"templates/admin/base.html\",\n    \"line\": 35,\n    \"summary\": \"console_root(request) is called again for every link (6 times in the nav alone, again per row in loops such as guides.html and dashboard.html), recomputing the same string each time.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A Guide list of N rows calls console_root N+8 times per render, giving the same value each time. One `{% set root = console_root(request) %}` at the top of base.html, or a context value, does it once.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"tests/test_t03_guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 439,\n    \"summary\": \"These assertions are hard-coded to the URL depth of the page that rendered them (\\\"../../..\\\", \\\"../admin/heroes\\\", \\\"../logout\\\"), so they break on harmless changes to a page's depth. The crawl test resolves links instead, which is more robust.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"If the dashboard moves to /admin/ or the edit route drops a segment, these tests fail even though the links still resolve. Each one also repeats the urljoin-and-check logic that test_console_links.check_page already does. Resolve the href with urljoin and compare the result instead.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/web.py\",\n    \"line\": 127,\n    \"summary\": \"home_for, login_required_handler and setup_required_handler still return root-absolute '/login', '/admin/setup' and '/admin/dashboard', so the redirect half of the console still assumes it is mounted at '/'.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Under the same prefixed deployment as the first finding, an unauthenticated request is redirected to /login and not /cms/login, which is a 404. The diff makes links relative but not redirects. Use request.url_for or the same root logic for Location headers so both halves agree.\"\n  }\n]\n```</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>52704</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>4</tool_uses><duration_ms>61969</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"}

Two are correctness bugs and the rest are cleanup. I didn't run the tests.\n\n- **Prefix bug (`app/web.py:70`):** `console_root` is only wrong when the console runs under a path prefix. Starlette 1.7's `request.url.path` includes that prefix, so the \"../\" chain walks back past it and every link drops it.\n- **Weak test (`tests/test_console_links.py:51`):** `check_page` accepts any 403 as \"this route exists\", so it never actually checks the Guide filter form's GET link.\n- **Cleanup:** a `&lt;base href&gt;` in `admin/base.html` would replace about 30 copies of the prefix; the prefix is also recomputed for every link; some test assertions are hard-coded to one URL depth; and `home_for`/`redirect` still use root-absolute paths, though those are redirect headers rather than HTML.\n- **No CLAUDE.md breaks:** I searched `templates/` and `app/` for `href|src|action|formaction=\"/` and got no hits.\n\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/web.py\",\n    \"line\": 70,\n    \"summary\": \"console_root counts slashes in request.url.path, which in Starlette 1.7 includes root_path, so under a path prefix the '../' chain climbs past the console root and every console link loses the prefix.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Run the console with `uvicorn --root-path /cms` (or behind a proxy that serves it at /cms). On /cms/admin/guides, url.path is '/cms/admin/guides', so console_root returns '../../'. Resolved from /cms/admin/, 'admin/guides' becomes /admin/guides and not /cms/admin/guides, so every nav link, form action and formaction is a 404. Count from request.scope['path'] with root_path removed, or count only the segments after root_path.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"tests/test_console_links.py\",\n    \"line\": 51,\n    \"summary\": \"check_page takes any 403 on a bare POST as proof that the target route exists, but POST /admin/guides exists (Guide create), so the Guide filter form's GET action is never checked as a GET and the 405 branch is dead.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"If the filter form's action were broken so it pointed at a POST-only route, or its GET handler went away, POST still returns the CSRF 403 and the test passes. The comment 'Form GETs (the Guide filters) carry no token and just answer' describes a path that never runs. Read the form's method attribute and GET method=get targets directly.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"templates/admin/base.html\",\n    \"line\": 35,\n    \"summary\": \"Altitude: the same prefix is pasted in front of about 30 links in 12 templates, when one &lt;base href=\\\"{{ console_root(request) }}\\\"&gt; in admin/base.html (or a per-request context value) would make every plain 'admin/...' link relative to the console root.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Every new console link has to remember the prefix by hand. A link added without it (for example href=\\\"admin/heroes\\\" on a depth-2 page) resolves to /admin/admin/heroes. Only the crawl test would catch it, and only for pages that test lists.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"templates/admin/base.html\",\n    \"line\": 35,\n    \"summary\": \"console_root(request) is called again for every link (6 times in the nav alone, again per row in loops such as guides.html and dashboard.html), recomputing the same string each time.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"A Guide list of N rows calls console_root N+8 times per render, giving the same value each time. One `{% set root = console_root(request) %}` at the top of base.html, or a context value, does it once.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"tests/test_t03_guides.py\",\n    \"line\": 439,\n    \"summary\": \"These assertions are hard-coded to the URL depth of the page that rendered them (\\\"../../..\\\", \\\"../admin/heroes\\\", \\\"../logout\\\"), so they break on harmless changes to a page's depth. The crawl test resolves links instead, which is more robust.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"If the dashboard moves to /admin/ or the edit route drops a segment, these tests fail even though the links still resolve. Each one also repeats the urljoin-and-check logic that test_console_links.check_page already does. Resolve the href with urljoin and compare the result instead.\"\n  },\n  {\n    \"file\": \"app/web.py\",\n    \"line\": 127,\n    \"summary\": \"home_for, login_required_handler and setup_required_handler still return root-absolute '/login', '/admin/setup' and '/admin/dashboard', so the redirect half of the console still assumes it is mounted at '/'.\",\n    \"failure_scenario\": \"Under the same prefixed deployment as the first finding, an unauthenticated request is redirected to /login and not /cms/login, which is a 404. The diff makes links relative but not redirects. Use request.url_for or the same root logic for Location headers so both halves agree.\"\n  }\n]\n```</result>\n<usage><subagent_tokens>52704</subagent_tokens><tool_uses>4</tool_uses><duration_ms>61969</duration_ms></usage>\n</task-notification>"},"uuid":"c2ffb9b4-3cdd-4c8a-9441-490206ea8c48","timestamp":"2026-10-17T18:59:23.392Z","permissionMode":"bypassPermissions","origin":{"kind":"task-notification","producer":"session-task","runId":"0mvcrewdn-42c0c273"},"promptSource":"system","turnOrigin":"task_notification","turnPosition":{"promptIndex":5,"turnIndex":6},"queueSkipAttachments":true,"userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"3ff39291-4e4b-4d18-bcb7-84dd59edec48","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return Read it before edits that depend on surrounding content.)"}]},"uuid":"0688e6df-102e-4f4d-a864-b98d53f003e2","timestamp":"2026-10-17T19:01:18.371Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/tests/test_console_links.py","oldString":"    full = root_path + path if path != \"/\" or not root_path else root_path + \"/\"","newString":"    full = root_path + path","originalFile":"\"\"\"#18: console pages link with relative paths only, and every link still\nreaches its page from whatever URL depth the page is served at.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom starlette.requests import Request\n\nfrom app import web\nfrom conftest import login\nfrom test_t01_login import new_editor_needing_setup\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import add_hero, add_patch, edit_link, submit\nfrom test_t03_guides import new_guide\n\nLINK = re.compile(r'\\b(href|src|action|formaction)=\"([^\"]*)\"')\nGET_FORM = re.compile(r'<form method=\"get\" action=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return LINK.findall(page)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"root_path\", [\"\", \"/cms\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path, prefix\", [\n    (\"/\", \"\"),\n    (\"/login\", \"\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides\", \"../\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides/5/edit\", \"../../../\"),\n])\ndef test_the_link_prefix_leads_back_to_the_console_root(path, prefix, root_path):\n    # Starlette puts a mount prefix (root_path) in front of the path itself.\n    full = root_path + path if path != \"/\" or not root_path else root_path + \"/\"\n    request = Request({\"type\": \"http\", \"method\": \"GET\", \"path\": full,\n                       \"root_path\": root_path, \"headers\": [], \"query_string\": b\"\"})\n    assert web.console_root(request) == prefix\n    assert urljoin(f\"http://testserver{full}\", f\"{prefix}login\") \\\n        == f\"http://testserver{root_path}/login\"\n\n\ndef check_page(c: TestClient, page_url: str, page: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"No root-absolute path on the page, and each link, resolved against the\n    page's own URL, reaches a console route that answers it.\"\"\"\n    found = links(page)\n    assert found, f\"{page_url} has no links\"\n    get_forms = GET_FORM.findall(page)\n    for attribute, target in found:\n        assert not target.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_url}: {attribute}={target!r}\"\n        resolved = urljoin(f\"http://testserver{page_url}\", target)\n        if attribute == \"href\" or (attribute == \"action\" and target in get_forms):\n            assert c.get(resolved).status_code == 200, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n        else:\n            # POST targets: an empty form is refused for its CSRF token (403),\n            # which only happens on a route that exists and accepts POST.\n            response = c.post(resolved, follow_redirects=False)\n            assert response.status_code == 403, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_patch(admin, \"6.7\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_console_page_links_relatively_and_its_links_work(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    guide_edit = new_guide(admin)\n    pages = [\"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/guides\", \"/admin/guides/new\",\n             guide_edit, guide_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\") + \"/preview\",\n             \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, \"/admin/patches\"]\n    for page_url in pages:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_form_reshown_at_a_deeper_url_still_links_correctly(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    action = hero_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    response = submit(admin, hero_edit, action, name_zh=\"\", name_en=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    check_page(admin, action, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_and_setup_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(client):\n    check_page(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n    # The T00 hello page borrows the public base template, whose stylesheet\n    # and home links only exist on the Site; its link into the console works.\n    hello = client.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert not [t for _, t in links(hello) if t.startswith(\"/\")]\n    assert (\"href\", \"login\") in links(hello)\n\n    new_editor_needing_setup()\n    login(client, \"new@example.test\", \"temporary-pw\")\n    check_page(client, \"/admin/setup\", client.get(\"/admin/setup\").text)\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":32,"oldLines":7,"newStart":32,"newLines":7,"lines":[" ])"," def test_the_link_prefix_leads_back_to_the_console_root(path, prefix, root_path):","     # assert response.status_code == 403, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, \"/admin/patches\"]\n    for page_url in pages:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_form_reshown_at_a_deeper_url_still_links_correctly(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    action = hero_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    response = submit(admin, hero_edit, action, name_zh=\"\", name_en=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    check_page(admin, action, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_and_setup_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(client):\n    check_page(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n    # The T00 hello page check_page(client, \"/admin/setup\", Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if not user.can(\"manage_game\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"只有管理员可以使用此页面。\", status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n","numLines":148,"startLine":1,"totalLines":148}},"displayPath":"app/web.py"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"314cf6b1-bfb2-4ff8-8cc4-6c0d3ea45eeb","timestamp":"2026-10-17T19:07:13.670Z","rendered":[{"content":"<system-reminder>\nCalled the Read tool with the following input: {\"file_path\":\"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/app/web.py\"}\n</system-reminder>"},{"content":"<system-reminder>\nResult of calling the Read tool:\n1\t\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\n2\tcookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n3\t\n4\tThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\n5\tusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\n6\tand pending flash messages. Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**\n\nStart a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:\n\nToolSearch with query \"select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_close_mcp\"\n\nAdd task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Make a doc here — not a local file, even when coding — only when the user asks for one, and make it FIRST: the turn's first tool call is its skeleton (title, byline, a `pending` block per section) — a reflex: send it before any search, file read, plan, `guide` or thinking it through; think once it is open — `batch( container = {\"kind\":\"project\",\"create\":{\"name\":\"<title>\",\"doc\":{\"blocks\":{\"asof\":{\"type\":\"date\",\"value\":\"<today>\"},\"me\":{\"type\":\"mention\",\"user\":\"me\"},\"s1\":{\"type\":\"pending\",\"intent\":\"Goals: the three outcomes this quarter commits to\"},\"s2\":{…}},\"markdown\":\"# <title>\\n\\n<?claude block asof?> · <?claude block me?>\\n\\n<?claude block s1?>\\n\\n<?claude block s2?>\"}}}, batch = [] )` (`<?claude block k?>` ↔ `blocks.k`); its ack links the doc → `open` it with your Artifact tool (none → start your next message with the link, once); they're likely watching it fill — keep them posted in a short line naming what you're on (outline up; now <topic>); findings go in the doc, not chat; then `guide( items = [\"topic.index\"] )`, research, and fill each section: `replace` its pending id with `## <heading>` + body; end with one line + the link, never the document.
